scope: Six configured Fresno river review groups, point forecasts only
manualChecks: Area Watch passes selected river area
Kings/Pine Flat raw normalized values cross-checked
Rapid James-to-Redinger change shows final Redinger sample
390x844 phone layout and scrolling without page/table overflow
dataSemantics: Model rates integrated over preceding intervals; lead-zero excluded
NWS full interval precipitation totals; partial periods stay unknown
10m vector magnitude to mph; no invented GFS gusts
Source initialization/update times separate from app check and valid window
Unknown coverage and source failures are independent
Comparison remains separate from existing WPC72h labels and countywide notification rules
privacy: Credential-free public points, bounded in-memory cache; no private record or browser persistence
